'''Narrators''' ---- '''Narrators''' are characters seen in a dialogue, which most commonly appears during matches. They can give you tips or information about the game, tell you about incoming enemies or simply talk to the player. Prior to the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], there were no '''Narrators''', instead there was only beginning text.
